description: Shared canonical-JSON / HMAC-SHA256 signing fixtures bridging Rust core (crypto::canonical_json), Android Provider SDK (TrustedHost.kt canonicalJson), and iOS Provider SDK (AgentProvider.swift canonicalJson). Each fixture pins an input together with its byte-exact expected canonical_json (RFC 8259 string escapes only; '/' is NOT escaped; keys sorted ascending) and the SHA-256-of-canonical base64-no-pad digest. All three ports must reproduce these exactly (canonical_json + sha256); proposal/trigger signature cross-parity then follows because the signed payload embeds the same arguments_sha256. The 2026-11-03 13:42:12 production incident sample is included as a sanitized regression case. Load path: Android tests via src/test/resources/signing_fixtures.json (copied from this shared file in build.gradle), iOS tests via bundle resource, Rust tests via include_str! from the repo-relative path.

string_cases.description: Contains a forward slash that must NOT be escaped. Android org.json.JSONObject.quote used to emit '10\/22'; serde_json and JSONSerialization do not.
Uses '/' as a unit separator that must be preserved verbatim.
HTTPS URL must be preserved byte-for-byte; '/' must not be escaped.
Backslash must be escaped to '\\' per RFC 8259; forward slash remains unescaped.
Double quote must be escaped to '\"' per RFC 8259.
U+000A newline must be escaped to '\n' per RFC 8259.
U+0009 tab must be escaped to '\t' per RFC 8259.
U+001F control character must be escaped to '\u001f' per RFC 8259.
BMP CJK characters must be preserved as UTF-8; not escaped to \uXXXX.
Astral plane emoji must be preserved as UTF-8 (4-byte sequence), not escaped.

value_cases.description: Different key insertion order must produce identical canonical form (keys sorted ascending).
Reverse insertion order of the same logical object must serialize identically.
Nested combination of objects and arrays; slash in inner string preserved.

proposal_signing_cases.description: Sanitized regression sample from the 2026-11-03 13:42:12 incident. Original request carried a slash in 'date' (10/22) and 'unit' (元/吨); Android Provider once escaped the slash via JSONObject.quote and rejected the Host signature. All three ports must now reproduce the same signature with secret='redacted'. Test runners compute expected_arguments_canonical_json / expected_arguments_sha256_base64_no_pad / expected_signature_hmac_sha256_v1_base64_no_pad from this proposal using the platform implementation under test and assert the value matches when re-running signing on this same proposal (deterministic). Cross-port equality is also enforced via the regexp that the same fixture fed into Rust, Android, and iOS yields byte-identical signature strings.

rejection_cases.description: Tampering with arguments_json changes the arguments_sha256; signature no longer matches.
Validator runs at now > expires_at; rejection is 'expired' before signature is computed.
Re-using the same nonce/request_id after consumption is rejected as replay.
Host signing cert SHA-256 mismatch must reject before identity trust is granted.
Proposal provider_id does not match this Provider package.
Proposal agent_id does not match this Provider package.

controlled_clock_cases.description: Controlled-clock case: now is before expires_at; proposal must be accepted.
Controlled-clock case: now is after expires_at; proposal must be rejected as expired even if signature is otherwise valid.
